reden: Not detected. The vulnerability concerns PhiFactory.updateArtSettings allowing artists to arbitrarily change URI, royalties, and soulBounded after creation. The audit report does not mention updateArtSettings or unrestricted post-creation setting changes. Its PhiFactory findings are about claim replay/quantity/imageURI not in signatures, createArt signature replay/config binding, and fee handling in claim/batchClaim—different code paths and root causes. Fixing the reported issues would not address unrestricted updates to art settings.
